audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 4 disagree with both the packet chart and their own whys. Page reads Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Skill/Skill/Kayle/Kayle; packet reads Skill/Lillia/Lillia/Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Kayle. whys[1] and whys[2] describe chipping an immobile melee Kayle for free, whys[4] says her R flips the lane to her.
audit.why: The mirror kayle__lillia already flipped exactly these three rows, so leaving them would put the two pages in direct contradiction on top of contradicting the whys printed under them.
audit.corrected: phases[1].side/win[1] and phases[2].side/win[2] -> Lillia; phases[4].side/win[4] -> Kayle. phases[4].why rewritten so the full layer stops promising a sleep-execute on the row Kayle takes over.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: zero sequencing cues and Kayle's abilities are never named in the content layer. Divine Judgment's cooldown is never given anywhere — it is 160/120/80s, which is the single most important number in the lane because rank 1 is 160 seconds.
audit.why: "Bait it, then kill" is unusable without knowing how long the reward window lasts. At rank 1 a baited R buys nearly three minutes.
audit.corrected: 160s at rank 1 written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[2].text; the 900-range 15s Celestial Blessing heal added to tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly says her invulnerability means your "delayed Lullaby can't burst through it", which describes the wrong mechanic. Lilting Lullaby applies Drowsy first and only then sleep, and the wake-up bonus damage is the payoff — Kayle's R is cast reactively inside that Drowsy delay, voiding the whole sequence. That is the actual interaction and it is the one the mirror kayle__lillia now teaches from her side.
audit.why: It changes the instruction from "my ult is weak into her" to "my ult is the bait that pulls a 160s cooldown" — and it stops the player from throwing R at a Kayle whose R is up.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[2].text, content.mid, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now state that she pops R inside the Drowsy window, with the 160s rank-1 cooldown attached.
sources: ownerKit R text "become Drowsy before falling asleep... extra damage on being forcibly woken up"

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Kayle "he/his" throughout (tldr, winCon, tradeGood, phases[3].why, breakdown.early/mid/wave/trading, report[0]/[3]) while the content layer correctly says "her".
audit.why: Two genders for the same champion on one page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tldr and report[0].t here; the rest needs a champion-wide sweep rather than a dozen cosmetic edits.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak: full Blooming Blows, compounding burn, and enough mana to grind down a Kayle who still has to walk at you in melee form. Stack Dream Dust, kite with Q move speed, and zone her off the wave — she cannot trade back. At 6 the lane flips: Lilting Lullaby's delayed sleep is great setup but it can't crack her ranged-form invulnerable R, and her ult turns her from punching bag into a real ranged carry. Get her low and starve her form timer rather than chasing a kill her R denies.
